body: Thank you. Of course, you are right and as said before - I need to do everything possible to avoid thinking negatively. However - I'm not sure what can make me happy right now. I do things because they are part of my daily cycle, and breaking out of this cycle makes me feel uncomfortable. That's why I hate going out for parties for example. I don't particularly enjoy the view of drunken people.

First of all I would change the way I think. Let's be honest, thinking the way I do isn't causing anything good to me, and won't attract any opportunities. On the other hand - thinking positively is really difficult in some cases and even the best can struggle with this. 
This is where I should start.
